knowledge.quote: Based on Plan Optik’s expert knowledge the wafers are developed in collaboration with customers such as OSRAM, Infineon, Motorola, Samsung, Honeywell and Bosch.

commitment.quote: Plan Optik AG, the leading manufacturer of structured Wafers is processing glass, quartz and similar materials since more than 40 years.

experimentation.quote: Dabei steht unverändert die Entwicklung neuer komplexerer Anwendungen und eigenständiger Produkte zur Vermeidung des steigenden Margendrucks im Fokus.
